# Fixture fonts (third-party, SIL OFL 1.1)

Latin subsets from Fontsource (https://fontsource.org), used so the fixture brand's specimens and the golden capture
don't depend on the machine's system fonts.

- Atkinson Hyperlegible 400 and 700 (Braille Institute of America): `OFL-AtkinsonHyperlegible.txt`
- Fira Mono 400 (The Mozilla Corporation and Telefonica S.A.): `OFL-FiraMono.txt`
